hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) TSC_OUT=$(pnpm exec tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v '^test/mocks'); LINT_OUT=$(pnpm run lint 2>&1); LINT_STATUS=$?; if [ -n "$TSC_OUT" ] || [ $LINT_STATUS -ne 0 ]; then REASON=$(printf '%s\n%s' "$TSC_OUT" "$LINT_OUT"); jq -n --arg reason "$REASON" '{"decision":"block","reason":$reason}'; fi ;; esac; }
